title: Compressible viscous flow and entropy-stable viscous fluxes

items.title: Ideal-gas compressible Navier–Stokes–Fourier model
items.statement: The ideal-gas admissible states, entropy, Euler fluxes, Newtonian stress, Fourier heat flux, and conservative balance law with fixed sign conventions.
items.strategy: Specify parameters, state variables, thermodynamic functions, stress convention, and PDE sign.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: The ideal-gas admissible state set is open and convex
items.statement: The set rho>0 and E>|m|²/(2rho) is open and convex, so conservative-state arithmetic means remain admissible.
items.strategy: Compute the perspective Hessian and use its convexity to verify the strict epigraph.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Strict convexity and entropy variables for the ideal-gas Euler flux
items.statement: The mathematical entropy has positive-definite Hessian on the admissible set, explicit entropy variables, a compatible Euler entropy flux, potential rho R u_j, and a locally invertible entropy-variable map.
items.strategy: Differentiate the ideal-gas entropy, prove Hessian positivity, derive the Euler entropy transport identity, and compute the entropy potential.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Explicit entropy-conservative two-point Euler flux
items.statement: A symmetric two-point ideal-gas Euler flux defined by the entropy-potential correction of the arithmetic conservative-state flux.
items.strategy: State the two branches and arithmetic-state convention for the potential correction.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Properties of the explicit entropy-conservative flux
items.statement: The defined two-point flux is well-defined, symmetric, consistent, satisfies the entropy-potential jump identity, and is locally Lipschitz on positive-state compact sets.
items.strategy: Use strict convexity for the diagonal case, algebra for symmetry and the jump identity, and a midpoint Taylor expansion for regularity.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Positive-semidefinite entropy-variable factorization of viscous flux
items.statement: The Newtonian–Fourier viscous flux equals a block matrix applied to entropy-variable gradients, and the block matrix factors as a sum of nonnegative strain, dilation, and heat terms.
items.strategy: Write velocity and temperature gradients in entropy variables and identify the symmetric block bilinear form.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Smooth ideal-gas Navier–Stokes–Fourier entropy identity
items.statement: Every smooth positive solution obeys the local mathematical-entropy balance with Fourier entropy flux and nonnegative viscous and thermal production.
items.strategy: Multiply the conservative balance by entropy variables and use the local viscous factorization.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Periodic diagonal-norm SBP compressible viscous scheme
items.statement: The periodic nodal semidiscretization using the explicit symmetric entropy-conservative Euler flux and the ideal-gas entropy-variable viscous blocks.
items.strategy: Specify the finite periodic index set, diagonal norm, derivative identities, nodal state convention, and semidiscrete operator.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Conservation and entropy dissipation of the periodic SBP scheme
items.statement: On the stated periodic diagonal-norm SBP grid, every admissible semidiscrete solution conserves all weighted conservative variables and has a nonincreasing total mathematical entropy with the exact nodal viscous-production sum.
items.strategy: Use skew SBP flux differencing for the inviscid pair and summation by parts plus the local block factorization for viscosity.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: One-dimensional orthogonal finite-volume viscous scheme
items.statement: The cell-centered one-dimensional uniform finite-volume diffusion operator using a symmetric positive-semidefinite entropy-variable face block and zero boundary fluxes.
items.strategy: Specify the interval cell-face mesh, midpoint admissible state, face block, shared flux, zero boundary fluxes, and cell balance.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Second-order face-flux consistency for the one-dimensional viscous operator
items.statement: For smooth positive cell-center data on the uniform one-dimensional mesh, the defined entropy-variable viscous face flux approximates the physical viscous flux at the face with error O(h²).
items.strategy: Use symmetric Taylor expansions of the conservative-state midpoint and entropy-variable difference, then use smoothness of the block matrix.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; the argument is a finite-dimensional Taylor estimate.

items.title: Entropy dissipation of the orthogonal finite-volume viscous scheme
items.statement: For the defined one-dimensional uniform finite-volume scheme, the weighted total entropy derivative is exactly the negative sum of face entropy-gradient quadratic forms and the total conservative state is conserved.
items.strategy: Pair each cell balance with its entropy variables and cancel the two signed contributions at each interior face.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Finite-budget positive-tube forward Euler loop
items.statement: A deterministic forward-Euler loop that accepts only candidates whose nodal states remain in a specified compact positive-state tube and otherwise returns the last accepted state with a stage status.
items.strategy: Define inputs, state check, accept and early-return branches, budget completion, and outputs.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Termination of the finite-budget guarded forward-Euler loop
items.statement: For every valid input with finite nonnegative step budget N, the guarded forward-Euler algorithm returns after at most N candidate evaluations and its returned status and accepted-step count obey the branch instructions.
items.strategy: Induct on the number of remaining budgeted stages and inspect the accept and early-return branches.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; the loop has a finite integer budget.

items.title: Conditional fixed-grid forward-Euler error bound
items.statement: On a fixed SBP grid, if the exact semidiscrete trajectory remains inside a compact positive-state tube with positive margin, the guarded forward-Euler loop completes for sufficiently small steps and has first-order global error with a grid-dependent constant.
items.strategy: Prove local Lipschitz and boundedness, estimate the one-step defect, apply the discrete Gronwall recurrence, and use the tube margin for acceptance.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

title: Compressible viscous flow and entropy-stable viscous fluxes — Examples

items.title: A periodic manufactured compressible viscous state
items.statement: A smooth positive stationary periodic ideal-gas state is an exact solution of an explicitly forced one-dimensional Navier–Stokes–Fourier balance.
items.strategy: Substitute the explicit density, velocity, temperature, energy, and forcing into each conservative balance.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Couette flow with the thermal wall entropy balance
items.statement: The constant-pressure heated Couette profile is a smooth positive steady ideal-gas solution and its outward thermal entropy flux equals the integrated viscous and thermal production.
items.strategy: Verify the steady mass, momentum, and energy balances and integrate the exact entropy identity.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

references.title: Jesse Chan, Yimin Lin, and Tim Warburton, Entropy-stable hybridized discontinuous Galerkin methods for the compressible Euler and Navier-Stokes equations, complete author preprint

items.title: An exact three-node inviscid-versus-viscous SBP entropy budget
items.statement: A three-node periodic skew SBP grid has zero inviscid entropy rate for the explicit entropy-conservative flux and a strictly negative viscous entropy rate for a stated positive-state data vector.
items.strategy: Verify the three-node SBP matrices, compute entropy-variable gradients, and evaluate the finite dissipation sum.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.

items.title: Entropy variables leave every compact positive-state tube near vacuum
items.statement: A positive-density sequence with density and pressure tending to zero has an unbounded density entropy variable and converges to the excluded vacuum boundary.
items.strategy: Evaluate the explicit entropy variables on a positive sequence and identify its limiting boundary state.
items.axiom_base: No choice axiom is used; all state spaces and grid sums are finite-dimensional.
